headline: UN calls for creating, within 1 year, a mechanism to limit the risks of AI
summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres called on the international community to create within one year a mechanism to mitigate the risks posed by artificial intelligence.
why: The United Nations sets the forum for global cooperation, and any AI risk framework could shape regulation affecting technology companies and their investors.
original_headline: La ONU pide crear en el plazo de 1 año un mecanismo que limite los riesgos de la IA
